items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: The interviewee discusses Celestan and Papa Solistan, but Miss Valenny is only mentioned by the interviewer as a third party who 'asked him if she could get in touch with Papa Solistan'. The interviewee does not mention knowing her personally.
